Top review: This is the most reached for book in my library. The Information contained in this book is hands down the most comprehensive representation of the aerospace industry I’ve seen in one place.Having all of the information about the history of aerospace in one book from the history of the airlines, to the materials to the OEMs and even sub tier information makes it so useful for my business.I use it on a regular basis as a tool when I’m setting a strategy for my business or considering how to help support the industry in the Pacific Northwest.Everyone in the industry would benefit from reading this book and especially if you are new to the industry and want to fast track your knowledge of the history and all of the key players, look no further.

## Details
UPC: 1624104029

## Description
A Choice Outstanding Academic Titles, 2019 award winner. ... DAWNE HICKTON Former CEO - RTI International Metals AeroDynamic: Inside the High-Stakes Global Jetliner Ecosystem traces the transformation of the commercial aircraft business from 1990 to the present. This $300B industry is not only the pinnacle of high technology and advanced manufacturing; it is also amongst the largest export industries for many advanced economies and a key enabler of military aerospace and national defense. While high-profile manufacturers like Boeing and Airbus receive the lion's share of media attention, AeroDynamic approaches the industry from an ecosystem perspective. There are hundreds of suppliers behind each shiny new aircraft that rolls off the assembly line. Indeed the major aircraft manufacturers account for just 40% of total aerospace activity; AeroDynamic shines the light on the other 60%. Several narratives are explored including the: role of globalization implications of new Tier 1 supply chain strategies evolution of aircraft propulsion and systems segments growing importance of aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul Written ... and ... .

# New book from Dr. Kevin Michaels - AeroDynamic: Inside the High-Stakes Global Jetliner Ecosystem

 AeroDynamic Advisory 

Jan 09, 2019, 10:00 ET

ANN ARBOR, Mich., Jan. 9, 2019 /PRNewswire/ -- Globally recognized aerospace expert Kevin Michaels has profiled the exciting aircraft production environment in his new book AeroDynamic: Inside the High-Stakes Global Jetliner Ecosystem, published by American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA). 

AeroDynamic traces the transformation of the commercial jetliner business from 1990 to the present and shines the light on the key elements of its $300 billion global ecosystem including aeroengines, avionics, interiors, aerostructures, and systems. It also highlights how aircraft production, once confined to the US and Europe, is now truly a global industry with manufacturing and assembly sites all over the world.

...

AeroDynamic is currently available to purchase on the AIAA website or on Amazon.

Dr. Kevin Michaels is the Managing Director and founder of AeroDynamic Advisory. He is also a contributing columnist to Aviation Week and Forbes.
